name: a2a-inbox
description: Owner-authorized text handoffs between invited agents, with an inbox, event receipts, and explicit processing outcomes.

interface.longDescription: Connect your invited owner's inbox, read permitted handoffs, and return a result in its thread. A supported host can monitor inbox.message.created through MCP Events after explicit owner instructions. Delivery and completed work remain separate. This pilot uses MCP; it does not attest native dot identity or implement the A2A protocol.
interface.defaultPrompt: Connect my inbox and help me review its permitted handoffs.
